name: ai-dlc
description: An agentic engineering team that runs the AI-DLC: 15 role-scoped agents (orchestrator, product owner, product, requirements, architecture, system design, engineering, SQA, review, docs, presentations, critique, research, DevOps, agent management), the full AI-DLC lifecycle (idea to release) plus eight named lifecycles, artifact handoffs and hard quality gates. Each project can customise the workflow (stages, hand-offs, gates and approvers, routing) in .ai-dlc/workflow.json. .NET and JS / TS (Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) are supported: init installs the stack's rules and test gate in .NET and Node.js repos; more languages will follow.

thresholdPercent.title: Auto-handoff: handoff threshold (% of the context window)
thresholdPercent.description: Share of the context window, 1 to 100, that triggers an automatic session handoff (Claude Code only; main or lead session only, never subagents or teammates). The window is the one Claude Code reports for the session, or, only when it reports none, 500000 tokens (defaultContextWindow), which matches neither documented window (200000, or 1000000 with extended context). Then, at the default 80%, the line is 400000 tokens: on a 200000 window the handoff waits for auto-compact, on a 1000000 window it comes at 40%; set thresholdTokens, an absolute token count that replaces this (details: ai-dlc README, The fallback window). A value in the repository's .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json, or its AI_DLC_AUTO_HANDOFF_THRESHOLD_PERCENT variable in the environment or a settings env, overrides this row; /ai-dlc:configure-auto-handoff shows which applies. A seeded session hands off no sooner than seedHeadroomTokens (default 40000) past its starting size; the panel above the prompt says so when this line leaves less room than that above the new session's starting size.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Auto-handoff: handoffs in a row without a message
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs allowed before you type a prompt, when no AI-DLC run is active. Past this, auto-handoff pauses until you send one. While the run a chain of handoffs belongs to stays active, the chain goes on until the run is done, blocked or abandoned. Overridden by .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json or AI_DLC_AUTO_HANDOFF_MAX_CONSECUTIVE.

briefTemplate.title: Auto-handoff: brief template file
briefTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells Haiku which sections to write when no AI-DLC run is active; with an active run, the handoff skill's session handoff template is used instead. Created with the defaults on first run; edit it to change the brief. A value in .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json overrides this row only in a folder Claude Code trusts.

instructionsTemplate.title: Auto-handoff: instructions template file
instructionsTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells the fresh session how to read the brief. Created with the defaults on first run. A value in .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json overrides this row only in a folder Claude Code trusts.

ignoreFiles.title: Auto-handoff: ignored files (regex)
ignoreFiles.description: Edited files matching this pattern are left out of the brief, such as auto-synced state or caches. Leave blank for none.

viewer.title: Auto-handoff: viewer address
viewer.description: Where auto-handoff serves a readable page for each brief, as host:port. "tailscale" as the host means this machine's Tailscale IP, so only your tailnet can open it; without Tailscale it serves on 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for no server; the link is then the local file. A value that is not host:port is ignored and logged. A value in .ai-dlc/auto-handoff.json overrides this row only in a folder Claude Code trusts.

keepaliveEnabled.title: Keep-alive: on
keepaliveEnabled.description: Pings the prompt cache while background tasks run (Claude Code only). Off: no pings, no status lines. Unset: the built-in default, listed in the plugin's hooks/keepalive/README.md. Overridden by AI_DLC_KEEPALIVE_ENABLED in a settings env or by enabled in .ai-dlc/cache-keepalive.json. A value from the two committed files, the env of .claude/settings.json and .ai-dlc/cache-keepalive.json, overrides this row only in a folder Claude Code trusts (see the keep-alive README, hooks/keepalive/README.md, Workspace trust); one from the env of .claude/settings.local.json always does, and this row itself is never gated.

keepaliveScope.title: Keep-alive: scope of /ai-dlc:keepalive <duration>
keepaliveScope.description: session (this session only) or machine (every session on this machine until /ai-dlc:keepalive clear --machine), unless --session or --machine is given. Unset: the built-in default, listed in the plugin's hooks/keepalive/README.md. Overridden by AI_DLC_KEEPALIVE_SCOPE in a settings env or by scope in .ai-dlc/cache-keepalive.json.

keepaliveStatus.title: Keep-alive: show the status lines
